name: Fire Torch Handheld
description: Always-on fire torch (handheld): a carried torch: the smallest and liveliest flame, about 0.8 m high, leaning with the movement of the bearer so its embers and a thin wisp of smoke trail away behind it.

attachment.notes: Attach the `torch_head` node at the TOP of the torch head (the mouth of the bowl), y = 0 there and the flame rising above it; the effect draws no torch, bracket, pole, bowl or hand. A handheld torch is parented to the hand socket, so the flame leans with the bearer. The four Fire Torch variants share every node id and control, so a game can swap them freely. Feed the global wind into Wind strength (0 calm, 1 light, 3 strong) and Wind direction (degrees around Y). It is always on and loops seamlessly; scrub Fire intensity up from 0 to light it.
